caption: The video captures a close-up of a dark, fibrous mound resembling coconut husk or soil, with a smooth white oval object resting in a shallow depression at its lower center. Small green plants grow around the mound, including a feathery sprout at left-center and leafy stems at top and right, with dried brown leaves at the upper-left and sunlit foliage behind. Throughout, the white object and the mound appear to hold their positions, with no visible translation, rotation, or deformation. The camera framing stays largely fixed, so the mound edges and mid-ground plants keep their relative placement, with only slight handheld drift. Illumination shifts: the upper and background foliage gradually brightens and washes out, most pronounced toward the end. This reads as a change in light or exposure rather than movement of the objects. The small plants show slight pose differences, consistent with a faint sway. The scene is otherwise quiet, defined by the resting white object and the slow brightening behind it.

endpoints are normal, not physical errors. Do not add unseen causes, onset, stopping or outcomes.
An internal editing cut is not evidence of physical motion connecting the views.

Check identification before physical interpretation: a reflection is not a separate actor;
a powder/smoke/liquid outline or shadow is not automatically the boundary of a solid object;
an apparent change caused by occlusion/viewpoint is not automatically material deformation.
Do not claim contact, bending, compression, melting, disintegration or structural recovery unless
the appropriate material/surface itself provides visible evidence. Do not infer a force or earlier
collision just because the visible configuration would be compatible with it.

camera tracking. A single visible texture/seam does not prove spin. Avoid unnecessary absolute
claims of stillness, no motion, no camera motion or 'exactly' synchronized changes.
Remove invented scene details and explanations, but keep clearly visible ongoing motion and
processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.

Small green plants grow around the mound, including a feathery sprout at left-center and leafy stems at top and right, while dried brown leaves lie at the upper-left and sunlit foliage fills the background. Throughout the excerpt the white object and the mound hold their exact positions, with no translation, rotation, or deformation.
